BarrageStance: +65% attack speed, +2 projectiles, -40% damage. One Ninja stance per run.
BreakingWheel: Shuriken expiry scatters 6 blades at 30% hit damage each.
Crescendo: Every 3 attacks: +1 temporary projectile. Fire at cap, then reset. Cap: 5 (+2 per extra rank).
CuttingReturn: Returning Fang hits each enemy once on return.
EmbeddedBlades: Hits embed up to 12 blades. On death, they scatter at 40% hit damage. Scattered blades cannot embed.
FinalPursuit: Fang kills trigger 1 extra strike at a nearby enemy.
ForkingProjectiles: Hits fork into 2 shots at 50% damage each. Forked shots cannot fork.
FragmentLoad: +1 embedded blade per hit, per rank.
GreatShuriken: Piercing shuriken hits repeatedly. +50% damage, -50% attack speed, -55% shot speed. Extra shots add size. One Ninja stance.
GrindingHalt: Shuriken briefly slows on its first elite or boss hit.
RelentlessFang: Repeat outward Fang hits on one enemy: +15% damage per hit, up to +75%.
ReturningFang: Homing blade returns and relaunches. Attack speed boosts travel speed; extra shots boost damage. One Ninja stance.
SerratedEdge: Repeat shuriken hits on one enemy: +15% damage per hit, up to +75%.
ShadowStep: Ninja dashes leave a clone that attacks once.
WideOrbit: Shuriken grows to double size over 10 m of travel.
BladeWave: Melee launches a wave at 40% attack damage.
BleedingEdge: Melee and waves apply Bleed. Each stack adds 10% of hit damage per tick.
Bloodletting: +1 Bleed stack per melee or wave hit, per rank.
BloodStance: +50% area, +30% attack speed, -60% damage. One Samurai stance.
BloodTransfer: On death, share 50% remaining Bleed damage with up to 5 nearby enemies.
ExecutionStance: +50% area, +70% damage, -40% attack speed. One Samurai stance.
SamuraiHeavyBlade: +20% Samurai attack damage. Converts to the chosen stance's damage upgrade.
+{Percent}% Samurai attack damage. Converts to the chosen stance's damage upgrade.
OverkillBurst: Melee and wave kills explode for excess damage. Explosions cannot chain.
ReturningBlade: Primary waves return to their launch point for another hit at 50% damage. Split waves do not return.
SplinterWave: Each wave's first hit bursts for 30% wave damage, applying Bleed nearby.
WaveMultishot: +1 Blade Wave per attack, per rank.
WaveStance: +25% damage and attack speed, -35% area. One Samurai stance. Unlock Blade Wave separately.
GrandEntrance: Swap boosts your next normal attack: Samurai slashes all around (6 m); Ninja fires 8 extra shots. Does not stack.
TagTeam: Every 5 basic attacks, your partner assists: Ninja uses her build; Samurai slashes and pushes up to 12 enemies.
MarkedBlade: Samurai hits Mark enemies. Ninja kunai consume Marks for bonus damage.
